inventory_completion_explanation: The twelve roadmap families were decomposed into their nonduplicate carrier, relation, record, evidence and falsification obligations. The inherited Earth-ionosphere, tipping and earthquake atoms are explicit rows inside that decomposition. The resulting seventy-four rows determine the count; no target count generated or truncated the inventory.
later_full_field_extensions: complete solid-Earth, geodesy and geomagnetism census
complete mineralogy, petrology, sedimentology, stratigraphy and palaeontology handoff
complete geomorphology, soils and landscape dynamics
complete hydrology, cryosphere, oceanography, atmosphere and meteorology
complete climate, palaeoclimate, forcing, feedback and attribution
complete ecology, biodiversity and coupled Earth systems
complete pollution, toxic transport and environmental quality
complete hazards, risk, resilience, resources and sustainability accounting
complete Earth observation, data assimilation and forecast-validation census

obligations.falsification_condition: Reject if system identity is claimed while a participating reservoir, interface, spatial boundary, timescale or observation class is silently erased.
obligations.statement: The Earth system is a declared joint organization of distinguishable reservoirs and interfaces whose state, boundary, scale and observation time remain explicit.
obligations.title: Earth-system identity

obligations.falsification_condition: Reject if membership or boundary changes without record, or if an unobserved remainder is treated as absent.
obligations.statement: An Earth reservoir is a source- and time-bounded carrier with explicit membership, stored quantity, interfaces and observation units.
obligations.title: Earth-system reservoir

obligations.falsification_condition: Reject if a transfer is counted on only one side, if orientation is lost, or if the interface is replaced by an ungenerated continuum.
obligations.statement: An Earth-system boundary distinguishes adjacent carriers while retaining every registered cross-boundary transfer, orientation and observation limit.
obligations.title: Earth-system boundary and interface

obligations.falsification_condition: Reject if favorable variables alone define the state or if missing and outside-scope entries are collapsed into absence.
obligations.statement: An Earth-system state is the complete registered assignment of stocks, relations and observation status at one declared time and scale.
obligations.title: Earth-system state

obligations.falsification_condition: Reject if a model output, interpolated field or uncalibrated reading is silently relabelled as direct observation.
obligations.statement: An Earth observation is a reconstructible source-to-instrument-to-processing-to-result trace with calibration, uncertainty, exclusions and quality flags retained.
obligations.title: Earth observation

obligations.falsification_condition: Reject if any unavailable or unresolved observation is converted into ordinary numerical zero or favorable absence.
obligations.statement: Observed absence, non-detection, censoring, missing data and outside-scope status are distinct Earth evidence classes and may not be merged.
obligations.title: Absence, non-detection and missingness

obligations.falsification_condition: Reject if closure is asserted after omitting a flux, changing units, mixing timescales or fitting a residual away.
obligations.statement: An Earth energy budget retains every registered source, storage change, transfer and export across a declared boundary before testing closure.
obligations.title: Earth-system energy budget

obligations.falsification_condition: Reject if chemical identity, phase, location, boundary transfer or unresolved stock is erased.
obligations.statement: An Earth matter budget follows distinguishable material carriers through storage, transformation, transfer and export without permitting disappearance.
obligations.title: Earth-system matter budget

obligations.falsification_condition: Reject if increased resolution is claimed without a source distinction or if merged histories are treated as uniquely recoverable without a record.
obligations.statement: An Earth information budget records which environmental distinctions are retained, merged, reconstructed or lost by observation and transformation.
obligations.title: Earth-system information budget

obligations.falsification_condition: Reject if an instantaneous rate is added to a stock without an interval or if cumulative transfer is presented as simultaneous occupancy.
obligations.statement: A stock is retained occupancy within a boundary; a flow is a counted transfer across an interface during a declared interval, and neither may substitute for the other.
obligations.title: Stock and flow distinction

obligations.falsification_condition: Reject if a role is assigned without direction and interval or retained after the measured transfer reverses.
obligations.statement: Source, sink and storage are boundary- and interval-relative roles assigned from the complete transfer record rather than permanent labels attached to an object.
obligations.title: Source, sink and storage roles

obligations.falsification_condition: Reject if a residual is deleted, reallocated by tuning or called closure outside the declared uncertainty and source boundary.
obligations.statement: Budget closure is exact agreement of independently reconstructed registered routes; any unexplained residual remains evidence rather than being distributed by fit.
obligations.title: Budget closure and residual

obligations.falsification_condition: Reject if a hand specimen name erases heterogeneous phases, alteration, provenance or measurement resolution.
obligations.statement: A geological material is a source-bound specimen class retaining chemical composition, material phases, texture, structure, provenance and observation scale.
obligations.title: Geological material identity

obligations.falsification_condition: Reject if continuity is inferred across an unobserved gap without recording the correlation rule and alternatives.
obligations.statement: A geological layer is a mapped material body whose extent, contacts, continuity, internal variation and uncertainty are retained.
obligations.title: Geological layer

obligations.falsification_condition: Reject if one local sequence is silently promoted to a global total order or if a contradictory contact is discarded.
obligations.statement: Stratigraphic order is a partial order over observed layers and events that retains unconformities, faults, intrusions and unresolved correlations.
obligations.title: Stratigraphic order

obligations.falsification_condition: Reject if a named cycle implies that every carrier returns or if intermediate transformations and exports are omitted.
obligations.statement: A geological cycle is a reconstructible network of material-state transitions whose carriers, paths, transfers, losses and recurrence boundary remain explicit.
obligations.title: Geological transformation cycle

obligations.falsification_condition: Reject if one matching property uniquely identifies a source while generated alternatives remain viable.
obligations.statement: Geological provenance is a source-to-path-to-deposit reconstruction supported by retained composition, age, alteration and competing-source evidence.
obligations.title: Geological provenance

obligations.falsification_condition: Reject if absence of record becomes proof of absence, if dating uncertainty is erased, or if a universal law is inferred from one contingent history alone.
obligations.statement: An Earth-history claim is a source-dated reconstruction over preserved records with temporal uncertainty, gaps, resolution and alternative histories retained.
obligations.title: Earth historical record

obligations.falsification_condition: Reject if an inversion model is presented as direct access or if incompatible observations and nonunique interiors are erased.
obligations.statement: An inferred Earth-interior compartment requires a reproducible property contrast across a declared boundary with its observation and inversion limits retained.
obligations.title: Earth interior compartments

obligations.falsification_condition: Reject if present surface flux is assigned to a unique interior source without a registered transport history.
obligations.statement: Earth internal heat is a complete source, storage and transport ledger distinguishing inherited, transformation and internally generated contributions.
obligations.title: Earth internal heat sources

obligations.falsification_condition: Reject if a fitted effective parameter replaces the missing carrier path or if distinct transport modes are silently merged.
obligations.statement: Interior heat transport composes admitted material conduction with counted carrier motion and phase transitions under explicit geometry and boundaries.
obligations.title: Interior heat transport

obligations.falsification_condition: Reject if local depth is generalized globally without evidence or if method-dependent alternatives are discarded.
obligations.statement: The crust-mantle boundary is an observation-bounded interface identified through retained composition, structure and propagation contrasts, not a globally uniform surface by premise.
obligations.title: Crust-mantle boundary

obligations.falsification_condition: Reject if a sharp line replaces an observed deformation zone or if motion is inferred without a time-indexed reference frame.
obligations.statement: A tectonic plate boundary is a zone of measured relative motion and deformation whose geometry, rate, distributed strain and observation interval are retained.
obligations.title: Tectonic plate boundary

obligations.falsification_condition: Reject if reference-frame change creates the claimed motion or if episodic and unresolved intervals are smoothed away.
obligations.statement: Tectonic motion is a reference-frame-bound history of relative displacement and deformation reconstructed from complete geodetic and geological records.
obligations.title: Tectonic motion and deformation

obligations.falsification_condition: Reject if orientation or loading history is lost or if a laboratory relation is applied across scale without an admitted handoff.
obligations.statement: Geophysical stress and strain retain load orientation, deformation, material state, path, rate and scale rather than reducing both to an unsigned scalar.
obligations.title: Geophysical stress and strain

obligations.falsification_condition: Reject if catalog time alone is treated as the rupture mechanism or if unobserved nucleation is asserted as measured fact.
obligations.statement: Rupture is a source-bound transition from stored deformation to propagating and arrested slip with fault geometry, loading history and unresolved segments retained.
obligations.title: Earth rupture process

obligations.falsification_condition: Reject if a processed arrival is treated as a direct interior image or if missing stations and phase ambiguity are erased.
obligations.statement: A seismic record is a source-medium-receiver propagation trace with phase identity, path, timing, calibration and alternative source or medium explanations retained.
obligations.title: Seismic propagation record

obligations.falsification_condition: Reject if catalogs with different thresholds or magnitude scales are pooled without a registered translation.
obligations.statement: An earthquake catalog is a method- and interval-bounded event set retaining detection threshold, location, magnitude scale, duplicates, uncertainty and completeness changes.
obligations.title: Earthquake catalog

obligations.falsification_condition: Reject if the catalog selects the exponent, if incomplete small events are treated as absent, or if one fitted line erases scale-dependent departures.
obligations.statement: An earthquake magnitude-frequency claim is an exact size-count relation over a complete declared catalog, with its exponent derived before blind comparison and all departures retained.
obligations.title: Earthquake magnitude-frequency law

obligations.falsification_condition: Reject if surface products uniquely determine an unobserved pathway without alternative reconstructions.
obligations.statement: A volcanic process is a complete material and state-transition record from generation through storage, transport and release, including failed and non-eruptive paths.
obligations.title: Volcanic process and eruption record

obligations.falsification_condition: Reject if water outside the observation boundary is treated as absent or if phase and chemical composition are erased.
obligations.statement: A water reservoir retains amount, phase, composition, location, boundary, residence interval and exchanges as distinct registered properties.
obligations.title: Water reservoir identity

obligations.falsification_condition: Reject if universal phase behavior is reowned by Earth Science or if environmental carriers and impurities are omitted.
obligations.statement: An environmental water phase handoff cites admitted physical and chemical phase laws while retaining source, destination, energy, solutes, boundary and time.
obligations.title: Environmental water phase handoff

obligations.falsification_condition: Reject if the name cycle implies closure while storage change, groundwater exchange or boundary export remains unregistered.
obligations.statement: The hydrologic cycle is a bounded reservoir-transfer network whose stocks, phase changes, atmospheric transport, precipitation, runoff, infiltration and exports remain counted.
obligations.title: Hydrologic cycle

obligations.falsification_condition: Reject if hydraulic head or a model surface is substituted for direct water identity, path and source evidence.
obligations.statement: A groundwater system is a material-bounded storage and transfer organization with recharge, paths, composition, residence and discharge observations retained.
obligations.title: Groundwater system

obligations.falsification_condition: Reject if ungauged reaches, diversions, floodplain storage or groundwater exchange are silently omitted.
obligations.statement: Surface-water organization is a directed storage and transfer network over rivers, lakes, wetlands and interfaces with complete catchment and observation boundaries.
obligations.title: Rivers, lakes and surface-water networks

obligations.falsification_condition: Reject if area alone is substituted for mass, if unavailable thickness becomes absence, or if distinct ice reservoirs are pooled without record.
obligations.statement: A cryosphere state retains snow, ice and frozen-ground identities, mass, extent, thickness, motion, age, phase transitions and measurement uncertainty.
obligations.title: Cryosphere state and transition

obligations.falsification_condition: Reject if a global mean erases vertical, regional or temporal structure required by the claim.
obligations.statement: The atmosphere is a layered, moving material and energy carrier whose composition, state, boundaries and exchanges with other Earth reservoirs remain explicit.
obligations.title: Atmospheric system identity

obligations.falsification_condition: Reject if dry, wet, local and global composition bases are mixed or if below-detection values become ordinary zero.
obligations.statement: Atmospheric composition is a source- and method-bound mixture record retaining species, amount basis, altitude, location, time, transformation and uncertainty.
obligations.title: Atmospheric composition

obligations.falsification_condition: Reject if a bulk fitted parameter substitutes for the registered carriers or if incoming and outgoing quantities use incompatible boundaries.
obligations.statement: An atmospheric radiative budget is a directional and spectral transfer ledger through atmosphere and surface with clouds, aerosols, storage and unresolved terms retained.
obligations.title: Atmospheric radiative budget

obligations.falsification_condition: Reject if cloud occurrence alone fixes its microphysics or if unresolved sub-grid structure is treated as absent.
obligations.statement: Atmospheric moisture and clouds are phase-resolved water organizations coupled to air motion, particles and radiation under explicit observation limits.
obligations.title: Atmospheric moisture and cloud organization

obligations.falsification_condition: Reject if one averaged velocity field is treated as the complete carrier history or if opposite orientations are encoded as negative proof magnitudes.
obligations.statement: Atmospheric circulation is a time-indexed network of air-mass motion and exchange retaining orientation, transported carriers, boundaries and unresolved scales.
obligations.title: Atmospheric circulation

obligations.falsification_condition: Reject if forecast skill selects the governing law, if adverse forecasts are dropped, or if a model trajectory is relabelled as measured weather.
obligations.statement: Weather is the observed atmospheric state and its finite-time transition record; a forecast is a sealed conditional consequence, not an observation or natural law.
obligations.title: Weather state and forecast boundary

obligations.falsification_condition: Reject if the observed resonant frequency selects the cavity law, if a universal wave law is reowned, or if engineering transmission claims are inferred from resonance alone.
obligations.statement: Earth-ionosphere resonance composes the admitted bounded-wave relation with the measured Earth-atmosphere cavity geometry and retains the complete source spectrum and uncertainty.
obligations.title: Earth-ionosphere resonant cavity

obligations.falsification_condition: Reject if a surface observation is generalized through depth or if basin and global records are mixed without weighting and provenance.
obligations.statement: The ocean is a basin- and boundary-resolved seawater organization retaining composition, state, depth, motion and exchanges with atmosphere, land, ice and seabed.
obligations.title: Ocean system identity

obligations.falsification_condition: Reject if practical and absolute composition bases are silently mixed or if missing species are treated as absent.
obligations.statement: Ocean composition retains dissolved, particulate and gaseous carriers, amount basis, depth, location, time, method and transformations rather than salinity as an answer-only scalar.
obligations.title: Ocean composition and salinity

obligations.falsification_condition: Reject if a single profile fixes a persistent layer globally or if density is imported without its admitted physical and compositional dependencies.
obligations.statement: Ocean stratification is a depth- and time-resolved organization of water masses defined by retained property contrasts, interfaces, mixing and observation uncertainty.
obligations.title: Ocean stratification

obligations.falsification_condition: Reject if a streamfunction or inferred path is treated as direct parcel history or if unresolved recirculation is erased.
obligations.statement: Ocean circulation is a carrier-resolved transport network retaining water-mass identity, direction, depth, mixing, exchange and observation interval.
obligations.title: Ocean circulation

obligations.falsification_condition: Reject if a transfer coefficient is fitted to close the budget and then presented as a forced Earth law.
obligations.statement: Air-sea exchange is a two-way, interface-bounded transfer ledger retaining carrier identity, direction, area, state, time and method uncertainty.
obligations.title: Air-sea exchange

obligations.falsification_condition: Reject if planetary tidal locking is reowned, if a local response is generalized globally, or if shoreline change is inferred from water level alone.
obligations.statement: A coastal tidal response consumes Astronomy-owned orbital forcing and Physics-owned wave laws while Earth Science owns the measured water, current, sediment and boundary response.
obligations.title: Coastal and tidal Earth-system response

obligations.falsification_condition: Reject if the averaging interval, distribution, extremes, spatial support or observation changes are omitted.
obligations.statement: Climate is a source- and interval-bounded distribution of Earth-system states, variations and extremes rather than one instantaneous weather state or mean.
obligations.title: Climate state

obligations.falsification_condition: Reject if one event proves a climate law or if a long-term distribution is used as a deterministic event forecast.
obligations.statement: Weather and climate are distinct evidence classes linked by declared aggregation and memory relations; neither may be inferred from an unlabeled timescale.
obligations.title: Weather-climate timescale distinction

obligations.falsification_condition: Reject if an internal response is relabelled as forcing or if the forcing is inferred solely from the response it is meant to explain.
obligations.statement: A climate forcing is a registered driver that changes a declared Earth-system boundary ledger while retaining identity, timing, spectrum, location and uncertainty.
obligations.title: Climate forcing

obligations.falsification_condition: Reject if correlation substitutes for a closed path or if the feedback magnitude is fitted from the same target used to validate it.
obligations.statement: A climate feedback is a closed response path that modifies a registered driver or budget; its orientation, path, delay and boundary must remain structural labels rather than negative proof scalars.
obligations.title: Climate feedback

obligations.falsification_condition: Reject if unexplained change is automatically labeled internal or if a short record establishes a depth-independent cycle.
obligations.statement: Internal climate variability is the source-bounded state-transition structure remaining after registered external drivers are retained, with recurrence and nonrecurrence both recorded.
obligations.title: Internal climate variability

obligations.falsification_condition: Reject if the tested driver set omits a viable alternative, if a model ensemble selects its own target, or if disagreement and failed transport rows are removed.
obligations.statement: Climate attribution requires a preregistered observation, candidate driver set, complete alternatives, controls and source-bound uncertainty; detection of change alone is not attribution.
obligations.title: Climate detection and attribution

obligations.falsification_condition: Reject if abrupt change alone establishes tipping, if the threshold is read from the validation target, or if reversible and ordinary-variable alternatives survive.
obligations.statement: An Earth-system tipping claim requires observed or independently reconstructed basins, forcing path, threshold crossing, hysteresis or return behavior and ordinary-variability controls; no universal physical half-One threshold is assumed.
obligations.title: Earth-system tipping boundary

obligations.falsification_condition: Reject if chemically distinct carriers are merged, if an unmeasured sink closes the budget by assumption, or if biological uptake is rederived rather than cited.
obligations.statement: The Earth carbon cycle is a species- and reservoir-resolved transformation and transfer network with isotopic, stock, flow, boundary and uncertainty records retained.
obligations.title: Earth carbon cycle

obligations.falsification_condition: Reject if oxidation states, biological processes or atmospheric and aquatic boundaries are silently merged.
obligations.statement: The Earth nitrogen cycle retains each chemical species, abiotic and biological transformation, reservoir, transfer and observation boundary.
obligations.title: Earth nitrogen cycle

obligations.falsification_condition: Reject if a named cycle asserts atmospheric equivalence or complete return without evidence.
obligations.statement: The Earth phosphorus cycle composes geological, chemical and biological carriers while retaining weathering, uptake, transfer, burial, return and boundary exports.
obligations.title: Earth phosphorus cycle

obligations.falsification_condition: Reject if Earth Science reowns biological mechanism or if an ecosystem observation is generalized without organism and environmental boundaries.
obligations.statement: Biosphere-Earth exchange cites Biology-owned organismal processes while Earth Science owns their measured coupling to atmosphere, water, soil and rock reservoirs.
obligations.title: Biosphere-Earth exchange

obligations.falsification_condition: Reject if ecological recurrence alone establishes planetary stability or if absent observations become absent interactions.
obligations.statement: A coupled ecosystem-Earth claim retains Biology-owned communities together with abiotic stocks, transfers, disturbances, observation effort and missing links.
obligations.title: Coupled ecosystem-Earth organization

obligations.falsification_condition: Reject if correlation becomes causation or if unequal observation effort is treated as biological difference.
obligations.statement: A biodiversity-environment relation is a sampling- and design-bounded comparison retaining taxonomic identity, habitat, pressure, response, confounders and missingness.
obligations.title: Biodiversity-environment boundary

obligations.falsification_condition: Reject if chemical forms, exposure, dose, endpoint or Medicine-owned health evidence are omitted.
obligations.statement: A pollutant is a source- and context-bound material form associated with a declared exposure and adverse endpoint; substance identity alone does not establish harm.
obligations.title: Pollutant identity and boundary

obligations.falsification_condition: Reject if co-location or correlation substitutes for the transfer chain.
obligations.statement: An environmental exposure claim requires a reconstructible source-to-path-to-receptor chain retaining carrier identity, transformations, timing, alternatives and controls.
obligations.title: Environmental source-path-receptor chain

obligations.falsification_condition: Reject if a fitted transport coefficient replaces missing path evidence or if unavailable downstream observations become absence.
obligations.statement: Environmental transport is a carrier-resolved pathway network that cites upstream physical and material laws and retains phase, direction, boundaries, transformations and uncertainty.
obligations.title: Environmental contaminant transport

obligations.falsification_condition: Reject if disappearance of the measured precursor is treated as destruction of matter or proof of harmless products.
obligations.statement: Environmental transformation is a condition-bounded chemical or biological transition network with precursors, products, alternatives, rates and persistence observations retained.
obligations.title: Environmental transformation and persistence

obligations.falsification_condition: Reject if concentration alone establishes accumulation without volume, input, output and time records.
obligations.statement: Environmental accumulation is an input-storage-output ledger over a declared reservoir and interval, including transformation, remobilization and unresolved stock.
obligations.title: Environmental accumulation

obligations.falsification_condition: Reject if a weighted index imports fitted choices, hides an adverse component or silently becomes a universal natural law.
obligations.statement: Environmental quality is a purpose- and medium-specific evidence vector retaining measurement methods, thresholds, provenance, uncertainty and missing components; no single index may erase them.
obligations.title: Environmental quality state

obligations.falsification_condition: Reject if convenience samples establish a global Earth relation or if failed and below-detection samples are removed.
obligations.statement: A field observation retains site selection, sampling design, effort, calibration, processing, exclusions and representativeness limits.
obligations.title: Field observation and sampling

obligations.falsification_condition: Reject if a retrieval product is called direct ground truth or if cloud, saturation and algorithm changes are erased.
obligations.statement: Remote sensing is a source-to-path-to-sensor-to-retrieval trace whose geophysical interpretation retains calibration, geometry, processing, validation and unavailable pixels.
obligations.title: Remote-sensing observation

obligations.falsification_condition: Reject if one modern calibration is assumed invariant through untested history or if proxy disagreement is discarded.
obligations.statement: A proxy reconstruction preserves archive formation, dating, calibration, resolution, uncertainty and competing environmental controls and remains distinct from direct observation.
obligations.title: Proxy and Earth-history reconstruction

obligations.falsification_condition: Reject if tuned performance is offered as structural proof, if observations leak into a sealed prediction, or if model and observation errors are conflated.
obligations.statement: An Earth model is a declared conditional simulation and data assimilation is a traceable state update; neither can select an SFT law or become an observation.
obligations.title: Earth model and data-assimilation boundary

obligations.falsification_condition: Reject if the target or score enters before sealing, if unfavorable forecasts are omitted, or if accuracy is treated as proof of an opaque law.
obligations.statement: Forecast validation compares a sealed forecast with later source-bound outcomes using preregistered targets, metrics, baselines and complete adverse and missing rows.
obligations.title: Earth forecast validation

obligations.falsification_condition: Reject if hazard is equated with impact, if a probability is asserted without a reference class, or if Earth Science reowns social, clinical or engineered consequences.
obligations.statement: Earth Science owns the physical or environmental hazard record; risk composes exposure and vulnerability at explicit Social, Medicine and Engineering handoffs, while resilience retains recovery capacities and failures.
obligations.title: Hazard, risk, resilience and disciplinary handoff

ownership_boundary.astronomy_handoff: Other planets, orbital populations and cosmic histories.
ownership_boundary.owned: Contingent Earth states and histories, Earth-system composition and coupling, Earth observations, reconstructions, attribution and environmental evidence.

scope: Earth-system objects, observations, budgets, geological history, interior and geodynamics, seismic and volcanic processes, hydrosphere and cryosphere, atmosphere and weather, ocean and coasts, climate, biogeochemical coupling, environmental transport and quality, evidence classes, hazards and categorical handoffs.
